This source file records the interaction design for `interactive_demo.html`.
The public demo is maintained directly in HTML/CSS/JS so it can run as a static
GitHub Pages page with bilingual controls and no build step.

## Interaction Model

Controls:

- normalize labels;
- normalize completed status;
- convert numeric columns.

Outputs:

- activity labels: `18 -> 4` when label normalization is on;
- class labels: `12 -> 4` when label normalization is on;
- completed labels: `4 -> 2` when completed normalization is on;
- usable rows: `19 -> 25` only when numeric conversion and completed normalization are on;
- paper-facing Methods note and state-specific feedback.

## Accessibility/Fallback

- Default language is Vietnamese.
- A `<noscript>` summary gives the complete before/after result.
- Only the changed feedback/note region uses `aria-live`, not the whole output panel.
- The workflow note is explicitly labeled as a learning note, not full copy/paste code.
